obligations.description: - `Plugins_System.md` still has a hook-name schism, missing `mutation_capable` on plugin tools, a `shell.env` bypass that can mutate PM control env vars, shadow approval paths via `permission.ask`, and Persona-disabled plugins whose tools remain callable.
exact_items: - `Plugins_System.md` still has a hook-name schism, missing `mutation_capable` on plugin tools, a `shell.env` bypass that can mutate PM control env vars, shadow approval paths via `permission.ask`, and Persona-disabled plugins whose tools remain callable.
